name: Harris
source:
Aurelius's personal servant.

Prince Aurelius' trusted aide is enigmatic and somewhat mysterious. he seems to have been with Prince Aurelius for a long time, as even some of his speech resembles the Prince's.

It's difficult to clearly guess his intentions, aside for the fact that a lot of the things he does is for his personal amusement.
